fields.title: Conditional thermal weather scenario
fields.finding: The coupled map shifts inherited clear-sky offsets with air temperature. Cloud, solar, wind, wet optical response, actual dry-sky radiation and thermally coupled buoyancy are not a measured joint weather model.
fields.missing_evidence: Measured optics and local sky/solar/wind histories; coupled thermal validation.

claim: The coupled map shifts inherited clear-sky offsets with air temperature. Cloud, solar, wind, wet optical response, actual dry-sky radiation and thermally coupled buoyancy are not a measured joint weather model. | Conditional thermal weather scenario
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery.
